name: Ganziq Index
author: Ahmed Salem

sections.description:
Ganziq Index connects WordPress to Google Search Console. The Free plugin is the required core for the separately distributed Ganziq Index Pro add-on.

Free includes URL inspection, indexing status, essential Search Analytics, country/device reporting, basic sitemaps, basic alerts, OAuth setup, diagnostics, and CSV export.

SEO Tools are displayed with a PRO badge. Their implementation is supplied by the separate Pro add-on and is not downloaded by this plugin.

External services

This plugin connects directly from the WordPress site to Google OAuth and Google Search Console APIs only after a site administrator configures Google API credentials and explicitly connects a Google account.

Depending on the feature used, the plugin sends the selected Search Console property, URLs requested for inspection, sitemap information, and Search Analytics requests directly to Google. Google returns Search Console data to the WordPress site. This data is not routed through Ganziq servers.

Google OAuth:
https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Google Search Console API:
https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools

Google APIs Terms of Service:
https://developers.google.com/terms

Google API Services User Data Policy:
https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Ganziq Index.
  2. Open Ganziq Index > Google Setup Guide.
  3. Configure Google OAuth and select a Search Console property.
  4. For Pro features, install and activate Ganziq Index Pro while keeping Free active.
sections.changelog:
1

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Added Google Search Console OAuth connection, URL inspection, essential Search Analytics, country/device reporting, sitemap management, alerts, diagnostics, and CSV export.
  • Added Site Health checks and copyable diagnostics for Google connection, credential encryption, cron scheduling, and recent sync state.
  • Added suggested Privacy Policy content describing the direct Google Search Console data flow.
  • Added secure Google credential storage using Sodium or OpenSSL encryption.
  • Added Retry-After-aware background retries with WP-Cron for temporary Google API failures.
  • Added CSV formula-injection protection for exported text fields.
  • Added external-service disclosure with Google API, terms, user-data-policy, and privacy links.
